thought.text: The system is under severe memory pressure: only 948Mi available, swap nearly exhausted. Let me get the timeline from the log to confirm the cause.

reasoning_content:
Memory is critically constrained at 948Mi available with swap nearly exhausted, and the system is under severe stress. The readiness probes are timing out under this pressure, which triggers the reloader to shut down the services. I'm checking the process-compose logs to understand the full timeline of what's happening.

The restart policy allows up to 2 restarts, and the service has already hit that limit, which is why it's marked as completed. I need to examine the logs more carefully to trace the exact sequence of events.

action.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== log size / last lines ==="; wc -l /tmp/process-compose.log
echo "=== any readiness-fail / exit / restart / stopped events ==="
grep -nEi "readiness check fail|process exited|stopped|exit code|restarting|restart policy|gave up|will not restart" /tmp/process-compose.log | tail -30
